newsitem.title: PERU: Red Cross confirms 225 hostages released in Peru.
newsitem.headline: Red Cross confirms 225 hostages released in Peru.

text.p: Chief Red Cross mediator Michel Minnig said 225 hostages had been released from the besieged Japanese embassy residence on Sunday night and that just over 140 more were still held inside.
"Two-hundred-twenty-five hostages have been set free and there remain a little over 140," Minnig said outside the residence.
"The freedom of the 225 is a very positive thing. We are going to continue working for the freedom of others," he added.
Red Cross officials then proceeded to read out a list of those set free Sunday night.
Waving and smiling, tired but apparently in good health, the released hostages were driven in buses straight to a police hospital in Lima without a chance to talk to waiting reporters.
